description: Fetch a Let's Encrypt certificate and key for one of this node's MagicDNS domains (`tailscale cert`). Requires HTTPS enabled for the tailnet.

cert_file.description: Absolute path to write the certificate to.

domain.description: One of this node's certificate domains, as reported by dns::status `cert_domains`.

key_file.description: Absolute path to write the private key to.

domain.description: Domain the certificate was issued for.

key_file.description: Path of the written private key.
